notes: Results as posted on ClinicalTrials.gov for NCT02578680; showing the primary outcome measures.
Pembrolizumab+Pemetrexed+Platinum Chemotherapy Followed by Pembrolizumab+Pemetrexed: 'Overall Survival (OS)' was posted as 'NA' (not estimable); no bar is drawn.

Progression-Free Survival (PFS) Per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1 as Assessed by Blinded Central Imaging: Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.52 (95% CI 0.43 to 0.64), p <0.00001; Pembrolizumab+Pemetrexed+Platinum Chemotherapy Followed by Pembrolizumab+Pemetrexed vs Control.
Overall Survival (OS): Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.49 (95% CI 0.38 to 0.64), p <0.00001; Pembrolizumab+Pemetrexed+Platinum Chemotherapy Followed by Pembrolizumab+Pemetrexed vs Control.
Progression-Free Survival (PFS) Per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1 as Assessed by Blinded Central Imaging: time frame 'Up to approximately 21 months'.
Overall Survival (OS): time frame 'Up to approximately 21 months'.
Error bars show the posted 95% confidence interval.
'KEYNOTE-189' matches 2 trials with posted results; showing NCT02578680, the largest (616 participants). Also matching: NCT03950674 (40 participants).
